an7.58:1.1: Cattārīmāni bhikkhave Tathāgatassa arakkheyyāni, tīhi ca anupavajjo.
an7.58:1.4: Natthi Tathāgatassa kāyaduccaritaṃ, yaṃ Tathāgato rakkheyya
an7.58:2.2: Natthi Tathāgatassa vacīduccaritaṃ, yaṃ Tathāgato rakkheyya
an7.58:3.2: Natthi Tathāgatassa manoduccaritaṃ, yaṃ Tathāgato rakkheyya
an7.58:4.2: Natthi Tathāgatassa micchā-ājīvo, yaṃ Tathāgato rakkheyya
an7.58:6.3: Tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā Māro vā Brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena paṭicodessati
an7.58:6.6: etaṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.
an7.58:7.1: Supaññattā kho pana me bhikkhave sāvakānaṃ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā,
an7.58:7.2: yathā paṭipannā mama sāvakā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti. --
an7.58:7.3: Tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā Māro vā Brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena paṭicodessati
an7.58:7.4: ‘iti pi te na supaññattā sāvakānaṃ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā, yathā paṭipannā tava sāvakā āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī' ti.
an7.58:7.6: Etaṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.
an7.58:8.1: Anekasatā kho pana me bhikkhave sāvakaparisā āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti. --
an7.58:8.2: Tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā Māro vā Brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena paṭicodessati
an7.58:8.3: ‘iti pi te na anekasatā sāvakaparisā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ ditth' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī' ti.
an7.58:8.5: etaṃ p' ahaṃ bhikkhave nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.
an7.58:10.1: Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri Tathāgatassa arakkheyyāni, imehi ca tīhi anupavajjo
